import datetime

def derive(record):
    derived = {}
    
    # Determine if the primary completion date is after 2017-01-18
    primary_completion_date = record["protocolSection"]["statusModule"]["primaryCompletionDateStruct"]["date"]
    if len(primary_completion_date.split("-")) == 3:
        derived["primary_completion_date_after_2017"] = datetime.datetime.strptime(primary_completion_date, "%Y-%m-%d") >= datetime.datetime(2017, 1, 18)
    else:
        derived["primary_completion_date_after_2017"] = False
    
    # Check if there is at least one location in the US
    us_locations = [loc for loc in record["protocolSection"]["contactsLocationsModule"]["locations"] if loc["country"] == "United States"]
    derived["has_us_location"] = len(us_locations) > 0
    
    # Check if the study is an interventional study
    derived["is_interventional_study"] = record["protocolSection"]["designModule"]["studyType"] == "INTERVENTIONAL"
    
    # Check if the study is studying an FDA-regulated drug product
    derived["studies_fda_regulated_drug"] = record["protocolSection"]["oversightModule"].get("isFdaRegulatedDrug", False)
    
    # Check if the study is studying an FDA-regulated device product
    derived["studies_fda_regulated_device"] = record["protocolSection"]["oversightModule"].get("isFdaRegulatedDevice", False)
    
    # Calculate the results submission deadline
    if derived["primary_completion_date_after_2017"]:
        deadline = datetime.datetime.strptime(primary_completion_date, "%Y-%m-%d") + datetime.timedelta(days=365)
        derived["results_submission_deadline"] = deadline.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    else:
        derived["results_submission_deadline"] = None
    
    return derived
